title: Live: Israeli military announces 'simultaneous strikes' on Tehran, Beirut
summary: Israel’s military said it carried out simultaneous strikes on Beirut and Tehran early Tuesday, targeting what it described as militant and strategic sites. Meanwhile, Iran hit the US embassy in Saudi Arabia’s capital with a drone strike, causing “limited fire” and minor damage, according to Saudi Arabia’s Defence Ministry. Follow our liveblog for the latest…
contentText: Lebanon's state-run National News Agency said Tuesday the Lebanese army was evacuating "advanced positions" along the Israeli border after Israel’s military said its troops were operating in southern Lebanon in what it described as a “forward defence posture". Meanwhile, Iran hit the US embassy in Saudi Arabia’s capital with a drone strike, causing “limited fire” and minor damage, according to Saudi Arabia’s Defence Ministry. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
